query:
SELECT id, name, email, procurementRole, approvalLevel, phone, passwordHash IS NOT NULL as has_password, active, createdAt
FROM users
WHERE email IN (
  SELECT email FROM users
  WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND email != ''
  GROUP BY email
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY email, id ASC;
